source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why does adding a procedure to a skill fail to guarantee that its steps can run?

options.text: The model must discover the procedure in its pre-training data
options.feedback: The procedure can be loaded from the skill into context. It need not have appeared during pre-training.

options.text: The system also needs the required tools and permissions
options.feedback: The procedure explains what to do. Actual execution depends on capabilities and access supplied by the surrounding system.

options.text: A skill must replace the harness before it can be useful
options.feedback: Skills guide the agent within its environment. They need not replace the software that runs tools.

options.text: A skill must be converted into learned parameters first
options.feedback: The course uses skills as instructions and resources during a run, without retraining the model.
